headline: Base Fighting Renews Across Four Fronts
war_summary: The latest return shows fresh motion in Mooring County and Weathered Expanse. Mooring, previously reported wholly Warden-held, now has eleven Warden bases and one Colonial; fifteen event rows were logged in the past day, eight in the latest six hours. Weathered’s balance has shifted from five Warden and one Colonial base to four and two, with three neutral; seven event rows came in six hours amid rising casualty rates. Callahan’s Passage also remains sharply active: four event rows arrived in two hours, though its count stands at nine Warden bases and one Colonial. Linn’s Mercy retains ten Colonial bases and one neutral, with five rows in two hours. Nevish Line’s ownership is unchanged at six Colonial and two Warden, but it has no event rows in the latest two hours; Stonecradle remains eight Colonial to one Warden and has had no recorded base event since the prior day. Event rows may include paired records for a single ownership change. The war remains unresolved, with 34 victory towns required.
